subject: two widgets linked in a box : impossible to change the input

messages.subject: two widgets linked in a box : impossible to change the input
parts:
HI everyone !!

Today, I am looking to build a reactive box in my shiny app.

To explain, I would like to show a box with two widgets linked (the second depends on the first) only after users click on an actionButton.

runApp(list(
  ui = bootstrapPage(
    actionButton("Sample2","hi!"),
    uiOutput("sample1")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
   
    A = list(blue = c("a","b"), black = c("d","e"))
   
    choixtemp = reactiveValues(temp = NA)
   
    observe({
      if(is.null(input$Sample2)){}
      else{
       if(input$Sample2 > 0){
         output$sample1 <- renderUI({
          
           if(is.null(input$SampleIn)){choixtemp$temp <- c("data loading ...")}
           else{
             input$SampleIn
            
             choixtemp$temp <- as.matrix(A[[grep(input$SampleIn,names(A))]])
           }
          
          
           box(width = 12,background = "navy", height = 100,
              
               selectInput("SampleIn", label = "",choices = names(A), multiple = FALSE, width = '100%'),
               selectInput("SampleIn2", NULL, choixtemp$temp , multiple = F, width = '100%' )
           )
          
         })
       }  
       
      }
    })
    }
 
))

However, the code runs in a loop and input$sampleIn remains in the first choice !!
I tried to put some isolate but at this moment, it blocks on "data loading"

Does anybody have an idea to solve this problem ?

Thank you very much !!!

Cha
